# allierays.com

> Allie Rays — building AI tools that make one person as effective as a team.

This is a personal blog about Applied AI, building real tools, and what actually works when you're shipping AI in production.

## Author

Allie Rays — Lead Enterprise PreSales Engineer at Go1, building Applied AI tools and platforms.

## Content

Posts are about:
- Applied AI in organizations — what it means, how to build a team
- AI tooling and automation — MCP servers, agentic architecture, Claude API
- Building in production — architecture decisions, what failed, what shipped

- /projects — Content Compass, GOPA, Amplify
